issues.jp_before: 窓[まど]が開[あ]い{ている|pt-teiru}ので、寒[さむ]いです。
issues.problem: Distractor た gives 開いたので寒い ('the window has opened, so it is cold'), which is close enough to the result-state meaning to be acceptable.
issues.action: Replaced distractor た with てしまう.

issues.jp_before: あそこで手[て]を振[ふ]っ{ている|pt-teiru}人[ひと]は誰[だれ]ですか。
issues.problem: Distractor た gives 手を振った人は誰ですか ('who is the person who waved?'), natural and close to the English.
issues.action: Replaced distractor た with てみる.

issues.jp_before: 山[やま]の上[うえ]には雪[ゆき]が積[つ]もっ{ている|pt-teiru}。

issues.action: Replaced distractor た with てしまう.
